note: filename = <constant name from canned_responses.py>.mp3 - see app/tts.py::named_cache_path(). 'text' is the reply as written (Markdown intact, for reference); 'spoken_text' is what a voice recording should actually say (Markdown stripped, paragraph breaks turned into spoken pauses). 'recorded' is whether that file already exists in data/voice_cache/ - a recording found there is served as-is and is never regenerated by this script. Save delivered audio as data/voice_cache/<filename> exactly as listed.
